facts.text: I'm asking Santa to help Mum. Tonight I'm setting the table so she can sit down for once.
facts.why: Cindy Lou never sets the table in the film. She sets a trap to catch Santa, and when she meets the Grinch she asks him to help her mum, who works too hard.
facts.fix: She works so hard and is always doing stuff for other people.
